explore-place.title: Wire in the meters
explore-place.prompt: Put the ammeter and voltmeter where they belong, with the switch closed.
hints: Current must flow through the ammeter.
The voltmeter goes across the resistor.
explore-place.success: Ammeter in the loop, voltmeter across the resistor: 120 mA and 12 V, and the meters don't disturb the circuit.
